name: network-scan-agent
description: Runs on the Home Termux phone (the only thing with an actual presence on Home's LAN) alongside Zigbee2MQTT. Listens for a scan request from cabin-backend over MQTT, browses Home's network via mDNS for the requested window, and relays each device found back over MQTT. See docs/MAINTENANCE.md's Home Location section for why this can't run in cabin-backend itself (mDNS can't cross Tailscale).
